title: The way her crooked skirt swings at each whack.
html_source: Bloom is a voyeur from the get go, behaviour which prevails through Ulysses: ‘Bloom is especially given to mixoscopy, whether it is in the erotic contemplation of the girl in Dlugacz’s butcher’s shop in 'Calypso’ or the sight of an imperious female figure in the door of the Grosvenor Hotel, when he thinks ‘Watch! Watch! Silk flash rich stockings white, Watch!’ (James Joyce and Sexuality, Richard Brown, p84).
